children: may test support at $104.51 per barrel, with a good chance of breaking below it and falling towards the $102.76-$103.50 range.
The contract failed three times to break resistance at $107.34. The failures, along with the fall below the lower trendline of a rising wedge, suggest a reversal of the uptrend from $97.11.
The fall may still observe a series of projection levels on the uptrend. Resistance is at $106.26, a break above which could lead to a gain into $107.34-$109.08 range.
On the daily chart, there seems to be a false break above resistance at $105.88. The market may either experience a pullback towards a presumed flag, or resume its downtrend from $109.97.
Key support is at $102.67, a break below which may trigger a fall into the $94.21-$98 range.
